legacy: Alan Kay is one of the most influential pioneers of modern computing. His work on object-oriented programming, personal computing, and graphical user interfaces helped shape the way people interact with computers today.
earlyLife: Alan Curtis Kay was born on 17 May 1940 in Springfield, Massachusetts, United States.
majorContributions: Development of Smalltalk, the Dynabook concept, educational computing, object-oriented programming, and graphical user interface research.
laterLife: After his work at Xerox PARC, Alan Kay continued researching computing, software design, and educational technologies.
whyImportant: Alan Kay helped establish many concepts that became fundamental to modern personal computers, software design, and human-computer interaction.
